content.text: {"quote_faithful":"yes","verdict":"confirmed","evidence_kind":"missing_justification","fatal":"yes","explanation":"The quotation is verbatim and accurately reflects the write-up’s conclusion that the equal-grid response works only when Liu’s cuts already occupy the requisite grid points. Nowhere later does the text provide another Xiang strategy. It merely states that a “different Xiang strategy” is needed and proposes computational exploration. Thus it never proves that, for every Liu division, Xiang can use at most n cuts to impose the claimed upper bound. This is load-bearing: without a universal Xiang response, no optimality upper bound is established."}
